findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a completed round's handback arrives after its hold was stopped and a replacement subagent started in the same session.
The Done-when item is: "A handback whose round number is not the open round names the open round and prints the exact handback command; with no open round it prints the next step." The printed retry retains `args.subagent` from the old handback, even though the replacement can have a different ID. Supplying the replacement's result with that command can send a commit nudge to the old subagent (`src/forge/native.py:348`) or record the old ID for a later continuation (`src/forge/native.py:168` and `:366`). The printed command therefore is not the correct handback for the open round.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a coordinator exits with a handout outstanding and a later session attempts a handback with the wrong round number; a replacement round can also belong to another live coordinator.
This branch treats any persisted `pending` record as an open round without checking its owner. A dead session's pending record survives queue pruning (`src/forge/machine.py:727`), although `src/forge/native.py:202` treats its lock as no longer live. The refusal nevertheless claims that round is open and prints a retry instead of the no-open next step. For a live round held by another session, it likewise prints a retry that the session check at `src/forge/native.py:265` immediately refuses.
findings.title: Functional: Recovery treats dead or foreign pending records as usable rounds

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a stopped round is replaced with a different subagent, or the coordinating session ends while a handout is outstanding.
The named proof invents a different round number in one live session and reaches the no-open case only after a successful handback. It therefore passes despite the stale-subagent retry and dead-session failures. The replaced-round test at `tests/test_tools_session_hold.py:196` also uses the same subagent ID for both rounds and does not run the printed retry. Extend the command-level proof to cover these cases.
